title: Tammy Shipley was supposed to be monitored in prison. Instead she died after drinking 20L of water
summary_full: If the Aboriginal woman had been checked at regular intervals as required, her ‘excess consumption of water’ would have been prevented, inquest finds• Warning: This article contains images of and references to Indigenous Australians who have diedGet our breaking news email, free app or daily news podcastThe death of an Aboriginal woman who collapsed after drinking at least 20 litres of water in a New South Wales prison cell was preventable and the result of systemic failures, a coroner has found.Tammy Michelle Shipley, 47, died at Silverwater women’s correctional centre on 20 December 2022.
